messages:
anya: bringing up 'lingua' (compact q5) on staging. quick smoke: zh->en BLEU looks fine but we see weird bracket mirroring in he/arabic outputs and some CJK ruby/furigana tokens dropped. cc: @cheng for tokenization, @hiroshi for bidi/rtl check
sam: can you paste an example output?
anya: sure — input: 
anya: `原文：(李先生) 今天去图书馆。`
anya: model output (zh->he): `׳אוּ (לִי סֶנְשֶן) הַיּוֹם הָלַךְ לְהַסְתַּכֵּל בְּסִפְרִיָּה.` — note the opening paren became U+2019 hebrew punctuation and parens order swapped
cheng: that looks like a detokenize/bidirectional reordering issue, possibly during post-detok where we reconstruct punctuation. did we run locale-specific detok rules?
anya: we used standard detok pipeline from lingua-vocab. no locale overrides.
hiroshi: also saw CJK ruby loss on ja->en tests: inputs with furigana annotations like `漢字(かんじ)` become `漢字` only, furigana stripped. might be token merging in quant kernels.
maria: metrics: baseline (float32) zh->en BLEU 28.1, lingua q5 BLEU 27.9 but chrF dropped more: 0.62 -> 0.57 on samples with parentheses/quotes. the drop mostly on RTL and annotated spans.
anya: running targeted eval suite now (small). will post results.
(eval-bot): queued job 9812: lingua q5 staging smoke -> started
sam: possible causes: 1) tokenization differences 2) postprocess unicode normalization (NFKC vs NFC) 3) bidi algorithm applied after punctuation swap 4) quantized kernel merging grapheme clusters
cheng: I pushed a quick diff to tokenization rules to preserve parenthesis as neutral tokens for he/ar locales: `preserve_brackets = True` — deploying to staging tokenizer v1.2.1
anya: nice. re-ran those examples after token patch:
anya: model output (zh->he) now: `(לי סנשן) היום הלך לספריה.` — order preserved but quote direction still odd in some cases.
hiroshi: I'll instrument the detokenizer to log bidi reordering steps. adding debug flag to runtime: `--detok-debug=1`
(eval-bot): job 9812: lingua q5 staging smoke -> finished (wall 2m 34s). artifacts: https://internal-ci/jobs/9812/artifacts.tar.gz
maria: artifact quick scan: detok debug shows we call ICU bidi with default para level, but some inputs are marked wrong script due to leading punctuation.
sam: can we force explicit RTL/LTR embedding markers during detok? maybe add U+202A/U+202B around spans based on lang tag. risk: may change downstream consumers.
cheng: alternative: ensure punctuation classification uses adjoining character script, not previous token. pushed small fix to classify paren direction by adjacent letter block.
anya: re-run after token + detok tweaks. also seeing furigana strip: looks like tokenizer merges `(` + kana + `)` into a single token under q5 quant merges. odds of merge increased due to smaller vocab mapping.
hiroshi: that suggests subword merge table differs between float and quantized runtime. checking kernel-level token id mapping.
maria: quick regression test plan: 1) targeted detok tests for he/ar punctuation 2) furigana preservation tests for ja inputs with ruby 3) compare token id sequences float vs q5 for same inputs 4) run small canary in prod on low-traffic workspace
anya: agreed. I'll assemble failing samples and open a PR with test vectors. cc: @cheng please hold tokenizer change behind feature flag until we verify float/quant id parity.
cheng: ack. I'll add a `token parity` smoke check in the pipeline: `python infra/check_token_parity.py --model lingua --quant q5`
sam: if parity fails, rollback quant merge table and re-run. also add a note in the bring-up doc about locale-specific edgecases.
anya: opening ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-4521 — description + samples + initial diffs. assigning to eng-ml.
hiroshi: timeline: instrument detok today, run parity check tomorrow, aim for canary next week.
maria: thanks team — this looks like a small but important locale regression. we'll monitor eval metrics and update the release checklist. :eyes:
anya: thanks all. will paste PR and artifact links in the ticket.
